conversation_arc.research_methodology: Web search across 4 rounds covering: top-grossing mobile strategy games, web3 gaming tokens, monetization models, player retention mechanics, live ops events, social features, cross-platform games, onboarding psychology, creator economies
key_discoveries: Clash of Clans: $7B+ lifetime, clan wars + shield economy = infinite retention
Monopoly GO: Highest IAP revenue 2025, Reward Flow — every reward triggers next reward
Roblox: $6.8B bookings, creator economy = self-sustaining ecosystem
Fortnite Creative: $722M+ creator payouts, in-island transactions
Coin Master: $100M+/month at peak, slot + raid hybrid, loss aversion + social pyramid
EVE Online: Player-driven economy, wealth concentration + player wars = emergent narrative
Genshin Impact: $1B+ annual, Primogems scarcity + character collection = FOMO engine
Axie Infinity: P2E collapse lesson — unsustainable economy without sinks
Whiteout Survival: $1.5B+, furnace progression = life-or-death urgency, alliance dependency

research_conducted: Whiteout Survival furnace mechanics (HQ caps everything, heat/reputation system, Fire Crystal endgame)
Alliance Championship (6 alliances, 5 rounds, 3 lanes, score-based fight order)
State vs State warfare (monthly cross-server, 4 phases, Sunfire Castle capture)
Hero Gear system (4 slots, two combat systems, offline exploration progress)
Social pressure engine (help timers, state-wide shame/glory, shield anxiety, recovery FOMO)
deliverables: Main Tower as Crew HQ (furnace equivalent)
Card Gear system (4-slot gear per card)

current_state.social_systems: 3-tier urgency + crew chat weaponization + dopamine engine

critical_gaps_identified: Server costs for real-time features (chat, push notifications, war matchmaking)
Regulatory compliance (crypto + gambling mechanics = legal gray area)
Onboarding friction (Web3 wallets scare normies — need social login first)
Data privacy (GDPR/CCPA for push notifications, chat logs, behavior tracking)
Offline progression decay (what happens after 30 days AFK)
Regional pricing (APAC markets need local pricing)
Voice chat safety (300% increase in adoption = toxicity risk)
Creator moderation (UGC = IP theft, NSFW risk)
Token volatility hedging ($ALK crash = player revolt)
Anti-whale protection (one whale dominates = everyone quits)
Responsible gambling design (streaks, loot boxes, token sinks)
